contentList.content: FeiYu

FeiYu warriors are masters of feather weapons and agile combat techniques. They wield the FeiYu dice system, capable of executing various elegant maneuvers, possess eagle-like keen vision, and display feather-light yet deadly attack styles in battle. 3rd Level - <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="FeiYu_SuperiorityDice">FeiYu Dice</LSTag>, learn FeiYu maneuvers 7th Level - <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="FeiYu_YuanMenSheJi">Gate Archery</LSTag>, learn additional maneuvers 10th Level - FeiYu dice upgrade to d10, learn additional maneuvers 15th Level - <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="FeiYu_Mastery">Feather Roost</LSTag> 18th Level - FeiYu dice upgrade to d12
FeiYu Dice
Master the essence of FeiYu maneuvers. Gain FeiYu dice that can be used to execute FeiYu maneuvers. FeiYu dice are restored on a short rest.
Gate Archery

The legendary archery skill of Lu Bu shooting through the gate. Your ranged weapon attacks deal additional physical damage equal to your <LSTag Tooltip="StrengthModifier">Strength modifier</LSTag> [1].
Meteor Chain Feather
Swift multi-target attacks like meteors. Attack up to 2 enemies simultaneously. Can target 3 enemies at 7th level, 4 enemies at 10th level, 5 enemies at 15th level, 6 enemies at 18th level.
Wind Swept Feather

Explosive attack that sweeps like a gale. Make a ranged weapon attack against the target, on hit creates an explosion at the target location, dealing physical damage to all enemies within range. Explosion radius grows with level: 4.5m at 3rd level, 6m at 7th level, 7.5m at 10th level, 9m at 15th level, 10.5m at 18th level.
Startling Swan Feather

Elegant ricochet attack like a startling swan. Attack primary target then ricochet to surrounding enemies. Initially ricochet to 3 enemies, 7/10/15/18th level can ricochet to 4/5/6/7 enemies respectively.
Startled Feather
Startled feather ricochet effect like a phantom flash. Deal half damage to enemies around the primary target.
Feather Roost
Your FeiYu maneuvers have reached the roost realm, perfected through practice. At the start of each turn, if your FeiYu dice are not at maximum, restore 1 FeiYu die.
Improved FeiYu Dice
Your FeiYu techniques have become more refined. FeiYu dice are improved to [1].
Mastered FeiYu Dice
Your FeiYu techniques have reached mastery. FeiYu dice are improved to [1].
